top_signals.title: Two Chinese Supertankers U-Turn in Hormuz as Risks Remain High
top_signals.summary: Two Chinese-linked supertankers have U-turned in the Strait of Hormuz as risks to shipping remain elevated, with prospects for a normalization of traffic dimming after President Donald Trump took a hard line on Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nigeria Kicks Off Election Race With President in Pole Position
top_signals.summary: Campaigning for Nigeria’s January election is officially underway, with voters in Africa’s largest democracy offered the same slate of candidates as three years ago — and many of the same challenges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
